token_vazio_rule: missing evidence, units, domain, data or falsifier blocks promotion

records.falsifier: reject if dimensions/types fail or corrected flow violates declared invariants

records.name: Integral de Coerencia Etica Phi-ethica
records.primary_gap: ethical meaning is not operationally derived from the quantum functional
records.correction: define measurable ethical metrics and a non-physical governance adapter before interpretation
records.falsifier: fail promotion if metrics, scale and mapping to decisions are unspecified

records.name: Equacao de Superradiacao Sintetica

records.correction: use a Floquet/scattering gain model with explicit pump, coupling and loss terms

records.name: Tensor de Mielinizacao Acelerada

records.name: Campo de Vetores de Vazio Quantico TOKEN_VAZIO

records.name: Funcao de Onda de Coerencia de 42 Atratores
records.primary_gap: state is unnormalized and no Hamiltonian establishes gravitational attraction or 42 stable attractors
records.correction: normalize by sqrt(H_42) and treat 42 as a finite basis/index until dynamics are independently defined

records.name: Equacao de Onda de Memoria Temporal

records.name: Fator de Amplificacao Fibonacci-Rafael
records.primary_gap: original sequence does not converge because phi>1 gives exponential envelope
records.correction: replace phi^i by phi^-i; convergent closed form is approximately 0.44968042643383016
records.falsifier: partial sums of corrected series must converge to the closed-form value; original must not be labeled convergent

records.name: Equacao de Difusao de Conhecimento em Redes

records.name: Equacao de Onda de Energia Negativa de Zeldovich
records.primary_gap: scalar field equation is coupled directly to a tensor-valued source and propulsion interpretation is unsupported
records.correction: define a scalar source contraction or a covariant tensor field equation and explicit energy conditions
records.falsifier: reject if source type/units are inconsistent or proposed observable violates the declared conservation law

records.name: Transformada de Laplace Toroidal
records.primary_gap: claimed topology preservation does not follow from this non-periodic Laplace kernel
records.correction: use torus Fourier characters exp(-2pi*i*(m*x+n*y)) for topology-respecting periodic decomposition
records.falsifier: periodic shift invariance and Fourier roundtrip on test functions over T^2

records.name: Entropia de Emaranhamento em T7
records.primary_gap: von Neumann entropy is standard but division by a coordinate Jacobian determinant is not invariantly justified
records.correction: retain S=-Tr(rho log rho); introduce geometry only through a defined measure/state construction
records.falsifier: result must be invariant under coordinate reparameterization of the same physical state

records.name: Equacao do Colapso de Coerencia
records.primary_gap: sintropia sigma and event direction are not operationally defined
records.correction: define sigma observable, epsilon units and event semantics; retain hybrid-system event integration
records.falsifier: event traces must reproduce declared threshold transitions without hidden discontinuity handling

records.name: Potencial entre Parabolas e Habilidades
records.expression_original: V=(1/2pi)int_0^2pi log(1+exp(s cos theta+p sin theta))dtheta
records.primary_gap: s and p require measurable scales before cognitive interpretation
records.correction: treat as a mathematical softplus angular potential until validated psychometric adapters exist
records.falsifier: pre-register mapping from measured variables to s,p and test predictive value against baseline

records.name: Equacao de Fragmentacao de Dados
records.primary_gap: sum is not bounded by one and therefore is not generally a probability
records.correction: compute latent score z as the sum and define P_frag=sigmoid(z)
records.falsifier: probability must remain in [0,1] and calibration must beat a stated baseline on held-out blocks

records.name: Equacao da Meta-Cognicao Parabolica
records.primary_gap: intention and observation derivatives require a causal/operational parameterization
records.correction: define differentiable intervention variables and normalize prediction error scale

records.name: Transformada de Gabor-Fractal
records.primary_gap: Box(tau) fractal window is undefined

records.falsifier: synthetic chirp/fractal-noise benchmarks must establish detection gain over ordinary Gabor transform

records.name: Equacao de Estado de um Gas de Atratores
records.primary_gap: 42 coefficients have no microscopic derivation and dimensions vary with m
records.correction: assign alpha_m dimensions so each term is energy and fit only justified finite virial orders
records.falsifier: information criteria/cross-validation must reject unnecessary orders and compare against standard virial EOS

records.name: Hiper-Plano de Decisao Etica
records.primary_gap: multiplying sign by a sigmoid conflates discrete decision and confidence calibration
records.correction: z=sum_i w_i Phi_i-theta; D=sgn(z); C=sigmoid(|z|/T)
